plan.scope: Unreviewed V2 visual plan aligned to the actual captured fighter profile and current native-renderer dispatch proposal. Original actionMap and every combat profile remain unchanged. Pure melee/mobility/super dispatch uses punch6; all back mobility dispatches guard1. Retained palm11 and tuck15 drawings are preserved and are not substituted into unsupported action slots.

concept.gaitScope: Two independently drawn basic step figures; anatomical opposite-phase or retail cycle fidelity requires actual Root counterreview. Tuck15 is a low recovery pose, not a certified complete roll cycle.

proposalLimits: Candidate pixel heights and pivots require physical review. A neutral pose on the same image can use a different drawn density; do not approve that value automatically.
Preview datum is proposed from contact pixels. Replace it with a reviewed pelvis/body axis where appropriate.
No source point is inferred from a gun bounding box. Native muzzle or release points must be supplied explicitly.
H values are unapproved per-page choices. Projected action pose density and KO proportions require real source magnification review.
Every source direction, basic walk phase and tuck recovery needs actual Root inspection; no retail animation certification.
